name: Marketing Video · UGC, Hypermotion & Ads
higgsfield_feature: Click to Ad · Hypermotion · UGC Hooks & Settings
summary: 32 template video Fuobe (Hypermotion, Mixed Media, UGC, TikTok) + 9 UGC Hooks, 14 Ambientazioni e 10 Ad Styles con audio MiniMax H3.

inputs.label: Template Video Marketing
inputs.default: Flat 2D animation: the product pops in as a die-cut sticker, bouncy squash and stretch, doodled stars and sparkles burst around it on a flat colour background

options.value: Flat 2D animation: the product pops in as a die-cut sticker, bouncy squash and stretch, doodled stars and sparkles burst around it on a flat colour background
options.label: [Motion 2D] Sticker Pop

options.value: Paper cut-out animation: layered paper shapes slide in like a theatre set and the product rises from behind them, gentle stop-motion jitter
options.label: [Motion 2D] Paper Parade

options.value: Pop-art comic panels flip one after another, each showing the product from a new angle with halftone dots and bold outlines
options.label: [Motion 2D] Comic Panels

options.value: A Swiss-style grid of colour tiles shuffles and slides; one tile opens to reveal the product, crisp geometric transitions
options.label: [Motion 2D] Grid Shuffle

options.value: Pure CGI commercial: the camera orbits the product on a dark stage as a sweeping light reveals its edges, then settles on a hero angle
options.label: [Hypermotion] Orbit Hero

options.value: Ribbons of glossy liquid swirl around the product and wrap it, then fall away to reveal it spotless, macro slow motion
options.label: [Hypermotion] Liquid Wrap

options.value: The product splits into an exploded view with its parts floating apart, then snaps back together, technical and precise
options.label: [Hypermotion] Exploded View

options.value: The product's ingredients rain down from above in slow motion and bounce around it, bright studio light, fresh and vivid
options.label: [Hypermotion] Ingredient Rain

options.value: A single spotlight snaps on and the product rotates on a turntable, dust motes in the beam, dramatic theatre mood
options.label: [Hypermotion] Spotlight Spin

options.value: The product drops into frame, bounces once on a coloured floor with a satisfying squash, and lands on its hero angle
options.label: [Hypermotion] Drop & Bounce

options.value: The product plunges into clear water in extreme slow motion, bubbles trail upward and light caustics dance across it
options.label: [Hypermotion] Slow Splash

options.value: Neon light bars sweep across the product in sync with a beat, reflections streak over its surface, night-club energy
options.label: [Hypermotion] Neon Sweep

options.value: Mixed-media scrapbook: torn paper, tape and doodles animate around a real photo of the product as pages flip
options.label: [Mixed Media] Scrapbook Flip

options.value: Risograph-print look with grain and slight misregistration; the product cycles through two-colour duotone frames
options.label: [Mixed Media] Riso Loop

options.value: A Y2K computer desktop: pop-up windows, chrome icons and a cursor open a window that shows the product
options.label: [Mixed Media] Y2K Desktop

options.value: Claymation diorama: tiny clay props and a little set animate in stop motion around the real product
options.label: [Mixed Media] Clay Diorama

options.value: Halftone street-poster collage: cut-out shapes and the product slide in with punchy, rhythmic cuts
options.label: [Mixed Media] Halftone Collage

options.value: A laptop and a phone float in a soft gradient space showing the app's interface, the camera drifts slowly between them
options.label: [SaaS] Device Float

options.value: A relaxed, honest review straight to the phone camera: what they liked, one small catch and why they'd still buy it again
options.label: [UGC Talking] Honest Review

options.value: They open the package at the kitchen table, pull the product out and react to it for the first time
options.label: [UGC Talking] Unboxing at Home

options.value: A get-ready-with-me morning routine where the product is the step they never skip
options.label: [UGC Talking] Morning Routine

options.value: They describe the problem they had before, show the product, and talk through the difference it made
options.label: [UGC Talking] Before & After

options.value: A 3-step how-to: they talk and demonstrate how they use the product at the same time
options.label: [UGC Talking] Quick Tutorial

options.value: A try-on haul: they show the product on, turn around for the camera and say how it fits and feels
options.label: [UGC Talking] Try-On Haul

options.value: Doorstep delivery: they pick up the parcel, open it right there and share their first impression
options.label: [UGC Talking] Delivery Day

options.value: A completely calm product review in an absurd place, played straight for laughs
options.label: [UGC Talking] Sky-High Review

options.value: Creator-led recommendation: “this little thing saved my week” — the problem, the product, the payoff
options.label: [TikTok] This Saved My Week

options.value: They lean in to share a clever hack with the product that most people don't know about
options.label: [TikTok] Secret Hack

options.value: First-person POV: we see their hands use the product in an everyday moment while they narrate
options.label: [TikTok] POV Camera

options.value: A messy situation turns fresh and tidy thanks to the product, with a satisfying reveal
options.label: [TikTok] Mess to Fresh

options.value: A couple at home tries the product together and banters about it
options.label: [TikTok] Couple Test

options.value: Fast, punchy talking-to-camera with jump cuts: three reasons to get the product
options.label: [TikTok] Direct to Camera

options.value: Opening hook: Something flies into frame and bonks the creator; a beat of surprise, then they laugh it off and pivot straight to the product.
options.label: ⚡ Product Hit

options.value: Opening hook: Opens on an extreme close-up of the collarbone, tilts slowly up to a flawless face, pulls back to selfie framing and holds a silent beat before the pitch.
options.label: 🎯 Spicy

options.value: Opening hook: A street interviewer asks a stranger an odd follow-up question; confusion builds until the stranger spots the product and starts a casual review.
options.label: 🎯 Interview

options.value: Opening hook: Mid-vlog, an absurd object drops into the creator's hand from above and they use it as a microphone to deliver a dead-serious review.
options.label: ⚡ Random Object Mic

options.value: Opening hook: The product tumbles from above and the scene glitches into chaos, then snaps back clean and calm as the creator begins reviewing it.
options.label: 🎯 Product Crash

options.value: Opening hook: A cozy room is hit by an impossible indoor blizzard; everything is covered in snow except the product, which keeps working perfectly.
options.label: ⚡ Blizzard

options.value: Opening hook: The camera bumps the creator's forehead by accident; they flinch, laugh, recover and naturally reveal the product while explaining it.
options.label: 🎯 Camera Bump

options.value: Opening hook: The product flies at the creator's face; they duck just in time, then pop back up already holding it and start the review as if nothing happened.
options.label: ⚡ Product Dodge

options.value: Opening hook: The creator attempts a backflip, lands badly, and without missing a beat pulls out the product and starts an unbothered review.
options.label: 🎯 Epic Fail

options.value: Setting: sitting up in bed against pillows, soft window light, rumpled sheets, a relaxed morning feel.
options.label: 🌍 Bedroom

options.value: Setting: outdoors on a trail, in a park or at the beach depending on the product, natural light, open sky.
options.label: 🌍 Nature

options.value: Setting: on a gym bench after a workout, bright overhead lights, equipment behind, freshly-finished energy.
options.label: 🌍 Gym

options.value: Setting: front-camera selfie in a bathroom, vanity lights, tiles behind, getting-ready energy.
options.label: 🌍 Bathroom

options.value: Setting: leaning on a kitchen counter in daylight, a mug and fruit in the background, casual midday vibe.
options.label: 🌍 Kitchen

options.value: Setting: selfie from the driver's or passenger seat of a parked car, window light on the face, between errands.
options.label: 🌍 In Car

options.value: Setting: walking down a city sidewalk, handheld selfie, storefronts and traffic behind, talking while moving.
options.label: 🌍 Street

options.value: Setting: at a desk with a laptop open and coffee nearby, soft overhead light, a quick mention between tasks.
options.label: 🌍 Office

options.value: Setting: sitting on the wing of a plane in flight above the clouds, wind whipping, completely unbothered.
options.label: 🌋 Airplane Wing

options.value: Setting: perched on the edge of a skyscraper rooftop at golden hour, the whole city below, totally relaxed.
options.label: 🌋 Rooftop Edge

options.value: Setting: sitting on the rim of an active volcano, lava bubbling below and smoke drifting past, zero reaction.
options.label: 🌋 Volcano Rim

options.value: Setting: shrunk to 15 cm tall and leaning on a giant version of the product, a normal selfie review at an impossible scale.
options.label: 🌋 Tiny Reviewer

options.value: Setting: sitting on the roof of a moving car on a desert highway at golden hour, swaying calmly as a truck passes.
options.label: 🌋 Car Roof

options.value: Setting: hanging out of the door of a moving train filming a selfie, wind pressing against them as the live demo.
options.label: 🌋 Train Surf

options.value: Commercial direction: authentic phone-camera UGC look, natural light, handheld. Tone: casual, first person, like telling a friend.
options.label: Ad Style · Simple UGC

options.value: Commercial direction: minimal studio shots on a soft seamless backdrop, slow controlled camera moves. Tone: calm, confident, few words.
options.label: Ad Style · Clean Minimal

options.value: Commercial direction: close-up hands unboxing the product on a clean desk, satisfying reveal. Tone: excited first impressions.
options.label: Ad Style · Unboxing

options.value: Commercial direction: testimonial selfie video at home, warm natural light. Tone: a genuine customer review with one specific detail.
options.label: Ad Style · Customer Reviews

options.value: Commercial direction: fast whip pans, punchy zooms and bold colour, maximum energy. Tone: fast, punchy, meme-aware.
options.label: Ad Style · Viral Chaos

options.value: Commercial direction: luxurious dark set, glossy reflections, slow elegant camera moves, gold accents. Tone: unhurried, refined, aspirational.
options.label: Ad Style · Luxury

options.value: Commercial direction: cinematic product story: materials, making-of details and the finished product. Tone: storytelling, warm narrator.
options.label: Ad Style · Product Story

options.value: Commercial direction: soft morning light, steam, blankets, the product in a slow morning ritual. Tone: gentle and warm.
options.label: Ad Style · Cozy Morning

options.value: Commercial direction: red-carpet glamour with camera flashes and a confident presenter. Tone: glamorous, playful hype.
options.label: Ad Style · Red Carpet

options.value: Commercial direction: soft neutral palette, linen and stone textures, graceful slow motion. Tone: soft-spoken and elegant.
options.label: Ad Style · Elegant Minimal
